study: Scalar vs channel-wise decay in the Anatomy of Associative Recall harness (dualgoose 8ca624a + Major-Project-Research patch)
frozen: 2026-11-18, before any training run of the scalar arms

arms.armed_gdn: published cell, unchanged: per-key-channel decay (the code is channel-wise although the paper text says scalar)
arms.armed_gdn_scalar: identical except the decay projection outputs one value per token, shared by all key channels

experiments.E1: MQAR K=32, d=32, 1 layer, bidirectional, 6000 steps, fp32, rebinding control; seeds 0-9. Upstream reference tag _h10.
experiments.E4: Haystack L=64, 4 pairs, dense 4, uniform distance curriculum, 2 layers, 2 heads, 3000 steps, fp32; seeds 0-9. Upstream reference tag _h5_d4c.
experiments.E5: E4 plus --collision and the rebinding control; seeds 0-9. Upstream reference tag _h10ck.
experiments.E6: Decay interventions on the armed_gdn checkpoints of E1, E4 and E5.

predictions.R0_reproduction: Our armed_gdn reproduces the published cells: E1 mean within 0.05 of the upstream _h10 mean; E4 and E5 lock-in counts not significantly different from upstream (_h5_d4c 6/10, _h10ck 3/10; Fisher two-sided p >= 0.05). If R0 fails, G1-G4 are not interpreted.
predictions.G1_capacity: E1: armed_gdn mean accuracy minus armed_gdn_scalar mean accuracy > 0, two-sided exact permutation test p < 0.05 over 10 vs 10 seeds. Both arms' rebinding accuracy must stay near the floors.
predictions.G2_distractors: E4: armed_gdn lock-in rate >= armed_gdn_scalar lock-in rate; Fisher exact reported. No direction is assumed significant.
predictions.G3_collision: E5: armed_gdn lock-in rate > armed_gdn_scalar lock-in rate, and among non-locked-in seeds the channel-wise arm's accuracy is not lower. Fisher exact reported.
predictions.G4_mechanism: E6, only if G1 or G3 shows a channel-wise advantage: fixed_channel_mean keeps most of the original accuracy while token_channel_average loses more.
predictions.null_rule: If G1-G3 all fail at 10 seeds: no detectable decay-granularity effect at constrained state in this harness. Thresholds are not changed after seeing results.
